title: Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack
excerpt: Mini Shai-Hulud malware was injected into keyv and eight related npm packages on August 4, 2026 after an attacker compromised the maintainer's GitHub account
content_html:
On August 4, 2026, attackers compromised the GitHub account of the maintainer behind keyv, a key-value storage library with roughly 127 million weekly npm downloads, and used that access to inject a credential-stealing worm across the entire package family. The same maintainer owns cacheable (29M downloads/month), flat-cache (565M downloads/month), file-entry-cache (557M downloads/month), and several other widely-used caching utilities, all of which were swept up in the same attack.

The compromise was carried out by pushing malicious files directly to the main branch and then immediately cutting a new release, meaning the poisoned versions were published to npm with valid provenance signed by GitHub Actions.

The compromised packages include:

  • keyv 6.0.0 (604M/month)
  • flat-cache 6.1.24 (580M/month)
  • file-entry-cache 11.1.6 (571M/month)
  • cacheable-request 13.0.20 (137M/month)
  • cacheable 2.5.1 (30M/month)
  • @cacheable/memory 2.2.1 (28M/month)
  • cache-manager 7.2.10 (16M/month)
  • @cacheable/node-cache 3.1.2 (6M/month)
  • @cacheable/utils 2.5.1 (34M/month)
  • @cacheable/net 2.1.1 (3.7K/month)
  • ecto 5.0.1 (4.5K/month)

We are also also seeing very active community spread of this supply chain worm to other maintainers and packages, including major organizations:

  • @deliveroo/reevent 1.0.1
  • @or-sdk/invitations 1.4.9
  • @picsart/ai-sdk 3.32.2
  • @qlik/embed-runtime 1.6.4
  • picasso.js 2.11.6

Update — August 4, 2026, 13:37 CEST: At least 434 packages (across 1381 versions) have been compromised by the worm, with a combined total of over 2 billion monthly installs at the time of writing.

What happened

Every package in the family received two new files, setup.mjs and Math_Symbol.js, along with a "preinstall": "node setup.mjs" entry added to each package.json. Anyone who ran npm install against an affected version would have had setup.mjs execute automatically before their install completed.

setup.mjs is a heavily obfuscated dropper. Its only job is to silently download the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and use it to execute the real payload, Math_Symbol.js:

execFileSync(<bun binary>, ['<script_dir>/Math_Symbol.js'], {
  stdio: 'inherit',
  cwd: <script_dir>
})

The Math_Symbol.js is a heavily obfuscated 728 KB JavaScript file containing credential stealers that harvest secrets from the victim's environment, encrypt the findings, and exfiltrate them to a public GitHub repository whose description reads "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again". The payload also contains worm-like propagation functionality to infect packages of other maintainers that have installed one of the compromised packages.

What it steals

The Math_Symbol.js file implements a set of credential extractors, each targeting a different secret store on the victim machine.

npm tokens

Reads ~/.npmrc and scans the filesystem for any other .npmrc files. Extracts authToken values and any //registry.*:_authToken=... entries. Validates each token live against registry.npmjs[.]org/-/whoami before exfiltrating.

GitHub tokens

Three token formats are targeted: classic PATs (ghp_...) and OAuth tokens (gho_...), GitHub App server-to-server tokens (ghs_...), and JWT OIDC tokens. Sources include ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, environment variables, and a filesystem scan.

On GitHub Actions runners, the payload also executes a shell command that reads the runner process memory directly to dump the entire secret store. It reads ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL to steal OIDC tokens used for npm publishing.

AWS credentials

  • ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.aws/config, parsing all named profiles
  • AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variables
  • EC2 Instance Metadata Service at 169.254.169.254, trying IMDSv2 first with a fallback to IMDSv1
  • ECS container metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2
  • AWS Secrets Manager, calling secretsmanager:ListSecrets across multiple regions to enumerate and exfiltrate all secrets stored there

Kubernetes secrets

Reads the service account token, CA certificate, and namespace from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/. Uses the service account token to query the Kubernetes API directly and retrieve all secrets in the namespace. Also targets KUBECONFIG and ~/.kube/config.

HashiCorp Vault tokens

Checks six sources in priority order: the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable, ~/.vault-token, the GitHub Actions runner path /home/runner/.vault-token, several well-known container paths, a Kubernetes auth login using the stolen service account JWT, and Vault's AWS IAM auth endpoint using any stolen AWS credentials. After obtaining a token, it enumerates all KV stores via /v1/sys/mounts and reads every secret from KV v1 and v2 paths.

Stripe and Slack tokens

Scans for Stripe API keys (both test and live, sk_ and pk_ prefixes) and Slack tokens (xox[baprs]-...) across all files touched by the filesystem scanner.

Generic filesystem scan

A platform-aware scanner (macOS vs Linux) runs roughly 200 glob patterns across the filesystem, targeting among other things:

  • .env, .env.*, and .envrc files
  • Private key files (*.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx, *.jks)
  • SSH keys and config (id_rsa, id_ed25519, .ssh/config)
  • Terraform state files and .tfvars
  • Docker registry credential files (docker/config.json)
  • KeePass databases (*.kdbx)
  • VPN configs (*.ovpn)
  • IDE config files including .vscode/tasks.json and .claude/settings.json

Files over 5 MB are skipped. Up to 64 concurrent reads are used. A generic regex engine is also applied across all scanned files, flagging PEM private keys, SSH public keys, Azure storage keys, database connection strings with embedded credentials, and generic key=value patterns matching common secret field names.

Exfiltration

Once credentials are harvested, the payload encrypts the entire bundle before sending it anywhere. Only the attacker, who holds the corresponding RSA private key, can decrypt what gets uploaded. This means the stolen data sits in plain sight on public infrastructure but is unreadable to anyone else.

The primary exfiltration destination is a public GitHub repository whose description contains the string "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again". At the time of writing, GitHub contains roughly 1,300 public repositories matching that string, each serving as a drop point for a victim's encrypted credential bundle.

If the GitHub upload fails, the payload falls back to https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router, a domain registered on 2026-05-22 that appears to serve no legitimate purpose. This domain is fetched dynamically from an Ethereum smart contract at 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103, allowing the attacker to rotate infrastructure at any time without touching the payload.

Self-replicating worm

Beyond stealing credentials, the payload actively uses them to spread the malware to other maintainers and repositories. It has two distinct infection vectors.

npm tarball infection

Using the stolen npm token, the payload calls https://registry.npmjs[.]org/-/npm/v1/tokens to list every package that token has publish rights to, then fetches and unpacks the current tarball for each one. Before republishing, it makes the following modifications:

  • Bumps the patch version by one (e.g. 1.2.3 becomes 1.2.4)
  • Adds "preinstall": "node setup.mjs" to the package scripts
  • Injects setup.mjs and math_init.js (functionally identical to Math_Symbol.js) into the package

It then repacks and publishes the modified tarball to the registry.

This is how the worm propagates beyond the original maintainer. After the initial compromise of the keyv maintainer, we observed over 400 packages being infected through community spread. These second-generation infections are identifiable by the use of math_init.js rather than Math_Symbol.js, since they were seeded by the npm tarball injection worm.

GitHub repo infection

When the payload finds a ghs_ token, it commits into every branch it can reach, up to 50 branches per repo, working through the most recently active branches first and skipping dependabot and copilot branches. It adds malicious hooks to .claude/settings.json and .vscode/tasks.json so that the payload executes automatically the next time any developer opens the repository in VS Code or starts a Claude Code session inside it, with no npm install required. The commits are authored as claude with the email claude@users.noreply.github[.]com and carry the message chore: update config, blending in with real commits.

Indicators of Compromise (IOCs)

Files

  • setup.mjs‍
    • SHA-256 54dc7ea54a1317cca0e890a2770630cf7fa6c97813e0cb9d2caa93012b350668
  • setup.mjs (community-spread version)
    • SHA-256 fd3ca4007b225fdf8de7af4345a19179d5efa8c4bb9205f88cda806e5684b1eb
  • Math_Symbol.js and math_init.js‍
    • SHA-256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc

Network

  • https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router — exfiltration endpoint
  • eth-mainnet.nodereal[.]io request containing 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103

Other

  • Any public GitHub repository with description containing "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again" — these are the attacker-controlled repos used for credential exfiltration.

sentences.en: GitHub tokens
sentences.zh: GitHub 代币

blocks.html_en: Three token formats are targeted: classic PATs (ghp_...) and OAuth tokens (gho_...), GitHub App server-to-server tokens (ghs_...), and JWT OIDC tokens. Sources include ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, environment variables, and a filesystem scan.

sentences.en: Three token formats are targeted: classic PATs (ghp_...)
sentences.zh: 针对三种令牌格式： 经典 PAT (ghp_...)

sentences.en: and OAuth tokens (gho_...), GitHub App server-to-server tokens (ghs_...), and JWT OIDC tokens.
sentences.zh: 和 OAuth 令牌 (gho_...)、GitHub 应用程序服务器到服务器令牌 (ghs_...) 和 JWT OIDC 令牌。

sentences.en: Sources include ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, environment variables, and a filesystem scan.
sentences.zh: 来源包括 ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml、环境变量和文件系统扫描。

blocks.html_en: On GitHub Actions runners, the payload also executes a shell command that reads the runner process memory directly to dump the entire secret store. It reads ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL to steal OIDC tokens used for npm publishing.

sentences.en: On GitHub Actions runners, the payload also executes a shell command that reads the runner process memory directly to dump the entire secret store.
sentences.zh: 在 GitHub Actions 运行器上，有效负载还执行 shell 命令，直接读取运行器进程内存以转储整个秘密存储。

sentences.en: It reads ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL to steal OIDC tokens used for npm publishing.
sentences.zh: 它读取 ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN 和 ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL 来窃取用于 npm 发布的 OIDC 令牌。

sentences.zh: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID、AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY 和 AWS_SESSION_TOKEN 环境变量

sentences.zh: EC2 实例元数据服务位于 169.254.169.254，首先尝试 IMDSv2，然后回退到 IMDSv1

sentences.zh: ECS 容器元数据端点位于 169.254.170.2

sentences.en: Kubernetes secrets

blocks.html_en: Reads the service account token, CA certificate, and namespace from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/. Uses the service account token to query the Kubernetes API directly and retrieve all secrets in the namespace. Also targets KUBECONFIG and ~/.kube/config.

sentences.en: Reads the service account token, CA certificate, and namespace from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/.
sentences.zh: 从 /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ 读取服务帐户令牌、CA 证书和命名空间。

sentences.en: Uses the service account token to query the Kubernetes API directly and retrieve all secrets in the namespace.
sentences.zh: 使用服务帐户令牌直接查询 Kubernetes API 并检索命名空间中的所有机密。

sentences.en: Also targets KUBECONFIG and ~/.kube/config.
sentences.zh: 还针对 KUBECONFIG 和 ~/.kube/config。

sentences.en: HashiCorp Vault tokens
sentences.zh: HashiCorp Vault 代币

blocks.html_en: Checks six sources in priority order: the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable, ~/.vault-token, the GitHub Actions runner path /home/runner/.vault-token, several well-known container paths, a Kubernetes auth login using the stolen service account JWT, and Vault's AWS IAM auth endpoint using any stolen AWS credentials. After obtaining a token, it enumerates all KV stores via /v1/sys/mounts and reads every secret from KV v1 and v2 paths.

sentences.en: Checks six sources in priority order: the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable, ~/.vault-token, the GitHub Actions runner path /home/runner/.vault-token, several well-known container paths, a Kubernetes auth login using the stolen service account JWT, and Vault's AWS IAM auth endpoint using any stolen AWS credentials.
sentences.zh: 按优先级顺序检查六个源：VAULT_TOKEN 环境变量 ~/.vault-token、GitHub Actions 运行程序路径 /home/runner/.vault-token、几个众所周知的容器路径、使用被盗服务帐户 JWT 的 Kubernetes 身份验证登录以及使用任何被盗 AWS 凭证的 Vault 的 AWS IAM 身份验证端点。

sentences.en: After obtaining a token, it enumerates all KV stores via /v1/sys/mounts and reads every secret from KV v1 and v2 paths.
sentences.zh: 获得令牌后，它通过 /v1/sys/mounts 枚举所有 KV 存储，并从 KV v1 和 v2 路径读取每个秘密。

sentences.en: A platform-aware scanner (macOS vs Linux) runs roughly 200 glob patterns across the filesystem, targeting among other things:

sentences.zh: .env、.env.* 和 .envrc 文件

sentences.zh: 私钥文件（*.pem、*.key、*.p12、*.pfx、*.jks）

sentences.zh: SSH 密钥和配置（id_rsa、id_ed25519、.ssh/config）

sentences.zh: Terraform 状态文件和 .tfvars

sentences.zh: Docker 注册表凭证文件 (docker/config.json)

sentences.zh: KeePass 数据库 (*.kdbx)

sentences.en: VPN configs (*.ovpn)
sentences.zh: VPN 配置 (*.ovpn)

sentences.zh: IDE 配置文件，包括 .vscode/tasks.json 和 .claude/settings.json

A generic regex engine is also applied across all scanned files, flagging PEM private keys, SSH public keys, Azure storage keys, database connection strings with embedded credentials, and generic key=value patterns matching common secret field names.

sentences.en: Files over 5 MB are skipped.

sentences.zh: 最多使用 64 个并发读取。

sentences.zh: 通用正则表达式引擎还应用于所有扫描的文件，标记 PEM 私钥、SSH 公钥、Azure 存储密钥、具有嵌入式凭据的数据库连接字符串以及与常见秘密字段名称匹配的通用键=值模式。

sentences.en: Exfiltration
sentences.zh: 渗漏

blocks.html_en: Once credentials are harvested, the payload encrypts the entire bundle before sending it anywhere. Only the attacker, who holds the corresponding RSA private key, can decrypt what gets uploaded. This means the stolen data sits in plain sight on public infrastructure but is unreadable to anyone else.

sentences.en: Once credentials are harvested, the payload encrypts the entire bundle before sending it anywhere.
sentences.zh: 获取凭证后，有效负载会在将整个包发送到任何地方之前对其进行加密。

sentences.en: Only the attacker, who holds the corresponding RSA private key, can decrypt what gets uploaded.
sentences.zh: 只有持有相应 RSA 私钥的攻击者才能解密上传的内容。

sentences.en: This means the stolen data sits in plain sight on public infrastructure but is unreadable to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 这意味着被盗数据位于公共基础设施的显眼位置，但其他任何人都无法读取。

blocks.html_en: The primary exfiltration destination is a public GitHub repository whose description contains the string "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again". At the time of writing, GitHub contains roughly 1,300 public repositories matching that string, each serving as a drop point for a victim's encrypted credential bundle.

sentences.en: The primary exfiltration destination is a public GitHub repository whose description contains the string "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again".
sentences.zh: 主要渗透目标是公共 GitHub 存储库，其描述包含字符串“Shai-Hulud：Here We Go Again”。

sentences.en: At the time of writing, GitHub contains roughly 1,300 public repositories matching that string, each serving as a drop point for a victim's encrypted credential bundle.
sentences.zh: 截至撰写本文时，GitHub 包含大约 1,300 个与该字符串匹配的公共存储库，每个存储库都充当受害者加密凭证包的放置点。

blocks.html_en: If the GitHub upload fails, the payload falls back to https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router, a domain registered on 2026-05-22 that appears to serve no legitimate purpose. This domain is fetched dynamically from an Ethereum smart contract at 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103, allowing the attacker to rotate infrastructure at any time without touching the payload.

sentences.en: If the GitHub upload fails, the payload falls back to https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router, a domain registered on 2026-05-22 that appears to serve no legitimate purpose.
sentences.zh: 如果 GitHub 上传失败，有效负载将回退到 https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router，这是一个于 2026 年 5 月 22 日注册的域名，似乎没有任何合法用途。

sentences.en: This domain is fetched dynamically from an Ethereum smart contract at 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103, allowing the attacker to rotate infrastructure at any time without touching the payload.
sentences.zh: 该域是从 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103 处的以太坊智能合约动态获取的，允许攻击者随时轮换基础设施而无需触及有效负载。

sentences.en: Self-replicating worm
sentences.zh: 自我复制蠕虫

blocks.html_en: Beyond stealing credentials, the payload actively uses them to spread the malware to other maintainers and repositories. It has two distinct infection vectors.

sentences.en: Beyond stealing credentials, the payload actively uses them to spread the malware to other maintainers and repositories.
sentences.zh: 除了窃取凭据之外，有效负载还积极使用它们将恶意软件传播到其他维护者和存储库。

sentences.en: It has two distinct infection vectors.
sentences.zh: 它有两种不同的感染媒介。

sentences.en: npm tarball infection
sentences.zh: npm 压缩包感染

blocks.html_en: Using the stolen npm token, the payload calls https://registry.npmjs[.]org/-/npm/v1/tokens to list every package that token has publish rights to, then fetches and unpacks the current tarball for each one. Before republishing, it makes the following modifications:

sentences.en: Using the stolen npm token, the payload calls https://registry.npmjs[.]org/-/npm/v1/tokens to list every package that token has publish rights to, then fetches and unpacks the current tarball for each one.
sentences.zh: 使用窃取的 npm 令牌，有效负载调用 https://registry.npmjs[.]org/-/npm/v1/tokens 来列出该令牌具有发布权限的每个包，然后获取并解压每个包的当前 tarball。

sentences.en: Before republishing, it makes the following modifications:
sentences.zh: 重新发布前，做了以下修改：

blocks.html_en: • Bumps the patch version by one (e.g. 1.2.3 becomes 1.2.4)

sentences.en: Bumps the patch version by one (e.g. 1.2.3 becomes 1.2.4)
sentences.zh: 将补丁版本提高一（例如 1.2.3 变为 1.2.4）

sentences.en: Adds "preinstall": "node setup.mjs" to the package scripts
sentences.zh: 将“preinstall”：“node setup.mjs”添加到包脚本中

blocks.html_en: • Injects setup.mjs and math_init.js (functionally identical to Math_Symbol.js) into the package

sentences.en: Injects setup.mjs and math_init.js (functionally identical to Math_Symbol.js) into the package
sentences.zh: 将 setup.mjs 和 math_init.js （功能上与 Math_Symbol.js 相同）注入包中

blocks.html_en: It then repacks and publishes the modified tarball to the registry.

sentences.en: It then repacks and publishes the modified tarball to the registry.
sentences.zh: 然后，它重新打包并将修改后的 tarball 发布到注册表。

blocks.html_en: This is how the worm propagates beyond the original maintainer. After the initial compromise of the keyv maintainer, we observed over 400 packages being infected through community spread. These second-generation infections are identifiable by the use of math_init.js rather than Math_Symbol.js, since they were seeded by the npm tarball injection worm.

sentences.en: This is how the worm propagates beyond the original maintainer.
sentences.zh: 这就是蠕虫病毒传播到原始维护者之外的方式。

sentences.en: After the initial compromise of the keyv maintainer, we observed over 400 packages being infected through community spread.
sentences.zh: 在 keyv 维护者最初受到攻击后，我们观察到超过 400 个软件包通过社区传播被感染。

sentences.en: These second-generation infections are identifiable by the use of math_init.js rather than Math_Symbol.js, since they were seeded by the npm tarball injection worm.
sentences.zh: 这些第二代感染可以通过使用 math_init.js 而不是 Math_Symbol.js 来识别，因为它们是由 npm tarball 注入蠕虫传播的。

sentences.en: GitHub repo infection
sentences.zh: GitHub 仓库感染

blocks.html_en: When the payload finds a ghs_ token, it commits into every branch it can reach, up to 50 branches per repo, working through the most recently active branches first and skipping dependabot and copilot branches. It adds malicious hooks to .claude/settings.json and .vscode/tasks.json so that the payload executes automatically the next time any developer opens the repository in VS Code or starts a Claude Code session inside it, with no npm install required. The commits are authored as claude with the email claude@users.noreply.github[.]com and carry the message chore: update config, blending in with real commits.

sentences.en: When the payload finds a ghs_ token, it commits into every branch it can reach, up to 50 branches per repo, working through the most recently active branches first and skipping dependabot and copilot branches.
sentences.zh: 当有效负载找到 ghs_ 令牌时，它会提交到它可以到达的每个分支，每个存储库最多 50 个分支，首先处理最近活动的分支并跳过 dependentabot 和 copilot 分支。

sentences.en: It adds malicious hooks to .claude/settings.json and .vscode/tasks.json so that the payload executes automatically the next time any developer opens the repository in VS Code or starts a Claude Code session inside it, with no npm install required.
sentences.zh: 它向 .claude/settings.json 和 .vscode/tasks.json 添加恶意挂钩，以便下次任何开发人员在 VS Code 中打开存储库或在其中启动 Claude Code 会话时，有效负载会自动执行，无需安装 npm。

sentences.en: The commits are authored as claude with the email claude@users.noreply.github[.]com and carry the message chore: update config, blending in with real commits.
sentences.zh: 这些提交是由 claude 编写的，电子邮件为 claude@users.noreply.github[.]com，并带有消息杂务：更新配置，与真实提交混合。

sentences.en: Any public GitHub repository with description containing "Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again" — these are the attacker-controlled repos used for credential exfiltration.
sentences.zh: 任何描述包含“Shai-Hulud：我们再次出发”的公共 GitHub 存储库 - 这些是攻击者控制的用于凭据泄露的存储库。

content_html_zh:
2026 年 8 月 4 日，攻击者入侵了 keyv（一个键值存储库，每周 npm 下载量约为 1.27 亿次）背后维护者的 GitHub 帐户，并利用该访问权限在整个软件包系列中注入了窃取凭据的蠕虫病毒。 同一维护者拥有可缓存（29M 下载/月）、平面缓存（5.65 亿下载/月）、文件条目缓存（5.57 亿下载/月）以及其他几个广泛使用的缓存实用程序，所有这些都在同一次攻击中被席卷。

这种妥协是通过将恶意文件直接推送到主分支，然后立即删除新版本来实现的，这意味着中毒版本被发布到 npm，并具有由 GitHub Actions 签名的有效来源。

受损的软件包包括：

  • keyv 6.0.0（604M/月）
  • 平面缓存 6.1.24（580M/月）
  • 文件条目缓存 11.1.6（571M/月）
  • 可缓存请求 13.0.20（137M/月）
  • 可缓存2.5.1（30M/月）
  • @cacheable/内存2.2.1（28M/月）
  • 缓存管理器 7.2.10（16M/月）
  • @cacheable/node-cache 3.1.2（6M/月）

发生了什么

该系列中的每个包都收到两个新文件 setup.mjs 和 Math_Symbol.js，以及添加到每个 package.json 中的“preinstall”：“node setup.mjs”条目。 任何针对受影响版本运行 npm install 的人都会在安装完成之前自动执行 setup.mjs。

setup.mjs 是一个严重混淆的 dropper。 它唯一的工作是从 github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ 静默下载 Bun JavaScript 运行时，并使用它来执行真正的有效负载 Math_Symbol.js：

execFileSync(<bun binary>, ['<script_dir>/Math_Symbol.js'], {
  stdio: 'inherit',
  cwd: <script_dir>
})

Math_Symbol.js 是一个严重混淆的 728 KB JavaScript 文件，其中包含凭据窃取程序，这些程序从受害者的环境中获取秘密，对结果进行加密，并将其泄露到公共 GitHub 存储库，其描述为“Shai-Hulud：我们再次开始”。 该有效负载还包含类似蠕虫的传播功能，可以感染安装了受感染软件包之一的其他维护者的软件包。

它偷了什么

Math_Symbol.js 文件实现了一组凭据提取器，每个凭据提取器都针对受害计算机上的不同秘密存储。

npm 代币

读取 ~/.npmrc 并扫描文件系统中的任何其他 .npmrc 文件。 提取 authToken 值和任何 //registry.*:_authToken=... 条目。 在渗漏之前根据registry.npmjs[.]org/-/whoami 实时验证每个令牌。

GitHub 代币

针对三种令牌格式： 经典 PAT (ghp_...) 和 OAuth 令牌 (gho_...)、GitHub 应用程序服务器到服务器令牌 (ghs_...) 和 JWT OIDC 令牌。 来源包括 ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml、环境变量和文件系统扫描。

在 GitHub Actions 运行器上，有效负载还执行 shell 命令，直接读取运行器进程内存以转储整个秘密存储。 它读取 ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN 和 ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL 来窃取用于 npm 发布的 OIDC 令牌。

AWS 凭证

  • ~/.aws/credentials 和 ~/.aws/config，解析所有命名配置文件
  • AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID、AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY 和 AWS_SESSION_TOKEN 环境变量
  • EC2 实例元数据服务位于 169.254.169.254，首先尝试 IMDSv2，然后回退到 IMDSv1
  • ECS 容器元数据端点位于 169.254.170.2
  • AWS Secrets Manager，跨多个区域调用 Secretsmanager:ListSecrets 来枚举和泄露存储在其中的所有机密

Kubernetes 的秘密

从 /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ 读取服务帐户令牌、CA 证书和命名空间。 使用服务帐户令牌直接查询 Kubernetes API 并检索命名空间中的所有机密。 还针对 KUBECONFIG 和 ~/.kube/config。

HashiCorp Vault 代币

按优先级顺序检查六个源：VAULT_TOKEN 环境变量 ~/.vault-token、GitHub Actions 运行程序路径 /home/runner/.vault-token、几个众所周知的容器路径、使用被盗服务帐户 JWT 的 Kubernetes 身份验证登录以及使用任何被盗 AWS 凭证的 Vault 的 AWS IAM 身份验证端点。 获得令牌后，它通过 /v1/sys/mounts 枚举所有 KV 存储，并从 KV v1 和 v2 路径读取每个秘密。

Stripe 和 Slack 代币

扫描 Stripe API 密钥（测试和实时、sk_ 和 pk_ 前缀）和 Slack 令牌 (xox[baprs]-...) 跨越文件系统扫描器触及的所有文件。

通用文件系统扫描

平台感知扫描仪（macOS 与 Linux）在文件系统中运行大约 200 个 glob 模式，目标包括：

  • .env、.env.* 和 .envrc 文件
  • 私钥文件（*.pem、*.key、*.p12、*.pfx、*.jks）
  • SSH 密钥和配置（id_rsa、id_ed25519、.ssh/config）
  • Terraform 状态文件和 .tfvars
  • Docker 注册表凭证文件 (docker/config.json)
  • KeePass 数据库 (*.kdbx)
  • VPN 配置 (*.ovpn)
  • IDE 配置文件，包括 .vscode/tasks.json 和 .claude/settings.json

超过 5 MB 的文件将被跳过。 最多使用 64 个并发读取。 通用正则表达式引擎还应用于所有扫描的文件，标记 PEM 私钥、SSH 公钥、Azure 存储密钥、具有嵌入式凭据的数据库连接字符串以及与常见秘密字段名称匹配的通用键=值模式。

渗漏

获取凭证后，有效负载会在将整个包发送到任何地方之前对其进行加密。 只有持有相应 RSA 私钥的攻击者才能解密上传的内容。 这意味着被盗数据位于公共基础设施的显眼位置，但其他任何人都无法读取。

主要渗透目标是公共 GitHub 存储库，其描述包含字符串“Shai-Hulud：Here We Go Again”。 截至撰写本文时，GitHub 包含大约 1,300 个与该字符串匹配的公共存储库，每个存储库都充当受害者加密凭证包的放置点。

如果 GitHub 上传失败，有效负载将回退到 https://npm-cache[.]com:443/router，这是一个于 2026 年 5 月 22 日注册的域名，似乎没有任何合法用途。 该域是从 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103 处的以太坊智能合约动态获取的，允许攻击者随时轮换基础设施而无需触及有效负载。

自我复制蠕虫

除了窃取凭据之外，有效负载还积极使用它们将恶意软件传播到其他维护者和存储库。 它有两种不同的感染媒介。

npm 压缩包感染

使用窃取的 npm 令牌，有效负载调用 https://registry.npmjs[.]org/-/npm/v1/tokens 来列出该令牌具有发布权限的每个包，然后获取并解压每个包的当前 tarball。 重新发布前，做了以下修改：

  • 将补丁版本提高一（例如 1.2.3 变为 1.2.4）
  • 将“preinstall”：“node setup.mjs”添加到包脚本中
  • 将 setup.mjs 和 math_init.js （功能上与 Math_Symbol.js 相同）注入包中

然后，它重新打包并将修改后的 tarball 发布到注册表。

这就是蠕虫病毒传播到原始维护者之外的方式。 在 keyv 维护者最初受到攻击后，我们观察到超过 400 个软件包通过社区传播被感染。 这些第二代感染可以通过使用 math_init.js 而不是 Math_Symbol.js 来识别，因为它们是由 npm tarball 注入蠕虫传播的。

GitHub 仓库感染

当有效负载找到 ghs_ 令牌时，它会提交到它可以到达的每个分支，每个存储库最多 50 个分支，首先处理最近活动的分支并跳过 dependentabot 和 copilot 分支。 它向 .claude/settings.json 和 .vscode/tasks.json 添加恶意挂钩，以便下次任何开发人员在 VS Code 中打开存储库或在其中启动 Claude Code 会话时，有效负载会自动执行，无需安装 npm。 这些提交是由 claude 编写的，电子邮件为 claude@users.noreply.github[.]com，并带有消息杂务：更新配置，与真实提交混合。
